store_data.about_the_game:
The megacorps own everything. The networks, the data, the city. You're a netrunner — one of the few who can fight back from the inside.

NETFALL is a cyberpunk roguelike deckbuilder where you infiltrate corporate networks one card at a time. Build your deck, exploit system vulnerabilities, and push deeper into hostile infrastructure until you reach The Mainframe at the heart of it all.

Every run is different. Every death teaches you something.

BUILD YOUR DECK. BREACH THE NETWORK.

Start each run with a small hand of cards and shape it into something lethal. Play exploits, deploy defenses, and stack status effects against corporate ICE that adapts to your strategy. With 263 cards across five hacker identities, no two runs play the same.

FIVE HACKERS. FIVE PLAYSTYLES.

Choose your identity before every run — each brings a unique deck and a different way to fight:

  • BRUTEFORCE — Raw damage and overwhelming force. Best for new runners.

  • GHOST — Stealth, trace manipulation, and strikes from the shadows.

  • SOCENG — Social exploitation, misdirection, and psychological warfare.

  • CRYPTOMANCER — Encryption barriers and impenetrable digital fortresses.

  • DAEMON — Self-modifying code and cascading process chains.

Three identities are locked behind reputation earned across runs — a reason to keep going even after you win.

NAVIGATE THE NETWORK

Each run takes you through a procedurally generated map of nodes — combat encounters, elite threats, events, shops, and rest points. Choose your path carefully. Forks collapse behind you. The route you don't take disappears. There is no going back.

Three sectors stand between you and the final target. Clear them all and the true objective unlocks — The Mainframe, a final gauntlet that separates runs that almost made it from runs that actually did.

THE TRACE SYSTEM

Corporate security is always watching. Your trace counter rises as you fight — let it max out and you take damage. Manage it. Suppress it. Or build a deck that benefits from walking the edge.

100 RELICS. ENDLESS SYNERGIES.

Every run hands you passive relics that fundamentally change how your cards interact. A relic that rewards you for exhausting cards. One that doubles the effect of your next exploit. One that turns your trace counter into a weapon. Finding the combination that makes everything click is the heart of NETFALL.

FEATURES

263 hackware cards across 5 hacker identities

100 passive relics with deep synergy potential

Procedurally generated network maps — no two runs identical

46 enemies across 3 sectors + a true final boss

Daily Challenge mode — one shared network, global leaderboard

Reputation system — unlock new identities across runs

Steam Cloud saves

10 Steam achievements

Jack in. The network is waiting.

store_data.about_the_game:
It’s simple. You’re an exorcist, he’s a ghost. Except… not really?

On a visit to a client’s haunted house, you find that this handsome ‘full-bodied apparition’ is a little more ‘full body’ than you’d anticipated.

There’s something wrong with Lorenn’s soul. Something wrong with this house. And with your client refusing to cooperate until you’ve finished the job…

Looks like you’ve got the world’s cutest half-dead roommate on your hands!

A love like broken glass is a cozy romance visual novel, featuring:

  • You, a self-trained exorcist with a penchant for teasing pretty boys.

  • Lorenn, an adorably clumsy post(ghost?)-grad with a penchant for being teased.

  • And a not-so-safe soul-linking ritual that twists his innocent feelings into obsession, spiralling quickly out of control… But that’s nothing you can’t handle, right?

From roommates, to friends, to literal soul-mates… Nobody ever said exorcism was easy. Love is even harder.

And when you’re all out of time, will either of you be ready to say goodbye?

Key features:

  • A gender-neutral protagonist, with appearance otherwise unspecified.

  • An original soundtrack that will make you bop your head or pluck at your heartstrings at any moment’s notice.

  • Adorable character sprites and event CGs.

  • A happy ending, but a healthy amount of angst.

  • 52k words (about over 4 hours of reading), and varying dialogue trees that’ll allow you to flirt and tease to your heart’s content.

  • The prettiest, most loveliest ghost boy that will stay in your soul forever.

CONTENT WARNINGS:

The following topics appear across the game’s story(+ = mild, ++ = moderate, +++ = frequent):

  • Depression ++

  • Death and the afterlife +++

  • Unhealthy attachment styles ++

  • Possessiveness and jealousy +

store_data.about_the_game:
STRATEGY MEETS LOOT (DECKBUILDING + LOOT)

It’s not enough to have the right cards; you need the right steel. In Scourge of Eldryngard, your hero's power stems from the synergy between your deck and your inventory. Find ancestral equipment, manage your arsenal, and forge items that drastically alter how your cards behave. Here, the loot dictates your tactics.

FORGE YOUR ARSENAL

Don’t rely on luck—trust the heat of the furnace. In Eldryngard, power isn't found in temples; it’s extracted from metal. Through a deep system of archaic metallurgy, you have total control over your arsenal's evolution:

  • Industrial Synergy: Create pieces that don’t just boost your numbers, but permanently modify how your cards function on the battlefield.

  • Mechanical Enhancement: Level up your equipment to face increasingly lethal threats.

  • Attribute Reforge: Adjust the components of your weapons and armor so they mold perfectly to your deck’s strategy.

  • Ancestral Ascension: Transform rare items into Ancestral Relics, unlocking the true potential of lost engineering to decimate the Xenos hordes.

A WORLD OF ENGINEERING AND METAL

Forget fireballs and mystic rituals. Eldryngard is a world of gears, steel, and resilience. Survival depends on archaic technology and the coldness of tactical combat. Face the biological aberrations that have invaded the realm and unravel the mystery behind Malkorath’s madness in a realistic journey where every strike has weight and consequence.

MASTER UNIQUE FIGHTING STYLES

Each survivor brings a distinct combat style. Master deep mechanics that demand more than just luck:

  • Draegor, the Royal Guard: The bulwark of Eldryngard. He uses heavy armor and a shield not just for defense, but to convert his Block into devastating blows. He is the master of survival and defensive strategy.

  • Aldrich, the Barbarian: A whirlwind of steel. Wielding a two-handed axe, he enters a state of uncontrollable Fury. The more wounded Aldrich is, the more lethal his area-of-effect attacks become.

  • Darian, the Poison Master: Silent death. Focused on debilitating the enemy with persistent Toxins, Darian wins battles through attrition, watching his opponents succumb before even delivering the final blow.

  • Hanako, the Yamatai Spy: Sequence precision. With her dual daggers, she utilizes a system of Combos and card flows. Her attacks strengthen with every card played in the correct order, punishing the enemy with a storm of cuts.

  • Elyndra, the Forest Warden*: Ballistic precision and biological vanguard. An expert in long-range shots with high-tension bows, Elyndra dominates the battlefield by keeping her distance. She utilizes the tactical support of Arctos, her combat bear, who acts as a living wall to defend her while she identifies and eliminates enemy weak points.

  • Zahara, the Siege Engineer*: Heavy ballistics and area denial. Zahara doesn't fight with elegance, but with raw mechanical force. Armed with a heavy siege crossbow, she fires massive bolts that pierce the toughest carapaces. As a master of rudimentary engineering, she controls the flow of combat by installing tactical traps that punish any enemy daring enough to advance.

*Note: Elyndra and Zahara will be available only in the final version of the game.

CAMPAIGN OR HARDCORE

  • Journey Mode: Explore a dense campaign through brutal Acts. Rest in towns, manage your deck, accept exclusive missions, and participate in infinite hunts to strengthen your hero. Progression here is persistent, and the world evolves with your victories.

  • Hardcore Mode: For veterans seeking the limit. Permadeath and procedural encounters inspired by the genre's greatest classics. Face 10 levels of progressive difficulty (Ascension) that make Eldryngard a near-impossible challenge for the unprepared.

TACTICAL ARCHITECTURE

In Eldryngard, knowledge is a resource as vital as steel. Every card found on the battlefield represents a combat module that you can integrate into your strategy. Store discovered techniques in your personal library and refine your deck to maximize each hero's strengths. Here, you don’t just play cards—you design the mechanics of your own victory, forging a deck that responds precisely to your command style.

THE SURVIVAL MARKET

The economy of war demands pragmatism. In the outposts scattered across the realm, you must manage your resources with surgical precision. Convert the spoils of past battles into capital, sell obsolete equipment to optimize your loadout, and acquire rare components, supplies, and experimental weapons. Knowing when to invest in a new piece or save resources for an Ancestral Forge is what separates the masters of survival from the victims of the Xenos scourge.

FROM THE ENTHUSIAST TO THE PLAYER
"Scourge of Eldryngard isn't just code in Godot; it’s the game that I, as a long-time fan of RPGs and deckbuilders, have always dreamed of playing. As a solo developer, I took on the challenge of creating a dense, tactical world that would normally require a team of dozens and hundreds of thousands of dollars in investment. To make this dream a reality, I embraced AI technology not as a shortcut, but as my technical ally. It allowed me to focus on what truly matters: balancing hundreds of cards, the depth of the forge, and the synergy with hundreds of items. Every piece of art, every line of dialogue, and every mechanic passed through my scrutiny and passion. This game is a tribute to persistence and the new era of indie development. It is proof that AI isn't here to replace human work, but to make the once impossible, possible."

store_data.about_the_game:
WELCOME TO THE WORLD'S FAIR HOTEL

Chicago, 1893. The World's Columbian Exposition is in full swing, a dazzling beacon of human progress. Just blocks away stands a magnificent new hotel, promising luxury and convenience to young travelers. You are one of them. Experience the story of Elizabeth, a young secretary hoping to start a new life in the big city. But the man who welcomed you, Dr. H.H. Holmes is not a hotelier, he is a madman. And his building is not a sanctuary, it is a machine designed to kill for profit.

"I was born with the devil in me. I could not help the fact that I was a murderer, no more than the poet can help the inspiration to sing..." — H. H. Holmes

Wake up to your worst nightmare. Behind soundproof walls and doors that lead to nowhere, the dark truth about America’s first serial killer awaits you.

KEY FEATURES

  • Authentic PSX Horror: Immerse yourself in a gritty, low-poly recreation of the Murder Castle in 1893, Chicago. 

  • Escape Room Mechanics: Interact with objects and use physics-based logic to uncover hidden keys and pathways. 

  • Deceptive Environments: Do not be deceived by this labyrinth of hidden passages, doors and stairs leading nowhere.

  • Pressured Survival: Manage your time in high-pressure traps where one wrong move is fatal. 

  • True-Crime Investigation: Search for hidden documents and clues to escape Holmes' grim operations.

The game is based on the sensationalized accounts of the 1890s yellow journalism.

store_data.about_the_game:
The line between the sacred and the abominable has vanished. You awaken at the center of an architectural and spiritual labyrinth designed to break the human mind.

This psychological horror experience plunges you into a visceral dark fantasy universe where tension is constant and resources are scarce.

Developed by a solo creator, Rotten Angel focuses on deep atmosphere, tense exploration, and a feeling of utter vulnerability in the face of the unknown.

  • Carefully navigate through dark, labyrinthine, and deeply corrupted environments. Every sound matte   

  • Have you ever faced a creature you cannot comprehend? How do you survive when you don't even know what your hunter wants?          

  • You are not the hero. And even if you were, this threat goes far beyond what magic and skill can handle. Run, hide, or use your environment and skills as best as you can to survive the hunts of the creature that follows.

  • Gather the fragments of a tragic history to understand the true nature of the "Rotten Angel" and the reason for your presence in this purgatory.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the ocean's grittiest underwater "car wash"!

Forget cars — here, your clients are gigantic, travel-worn whales seeking refuge after long journeys across the vast oceans. Under the watchful (and very grumpy) eye of Mr. Claw, your boss, you’ll wield custom tools forged from deep-sea salvage to restore these majestic giants to their former glory.

Dive into a meditative yet deeply satisfying cleaning experience set in a one-of-a-kind bio-industrial world.

The Cleaner’s Arsenal

Master a unique collection of tools crafted from seafloor junk and organic materials:

  • The Shell-Scraper: A sharpened mollusk shell bolted to a driftwood handle. Perfect for those stubborn, calcified growths.

  • The Battle Plunger: Essential for the delicate (and safe!) removal of toxic hitchhikers.

  • The Classic Sponge: The world’s most indispensable tool. Soft, reliable, and perfect for that final polish.

Deep-Sea Grime Won't Go Quietly

Cleaning a whale is no small feat. A whole ecosystem has made its home on your client’s massive body, and they won't leave without a fight:

  • Barnacles & Silt: Thick layers of crust and mud that require precision and patience to clear.

  • Ancient Algae: Sticky, stubborn greenery that needs some serious elbow grease to scrape away.

  • Toxic Jellyfish: They’ve latched on tight! Use the right tool to peel them off safely before they sting.

Pure Satisfaction & Hidden Treasures

Nothing beats the feeling of seeing glistening, clean whale skin emerge from beneath centuries of filth. Watch your progress bar climb to that perfect 100%!

For the most eagle-eyed cleaners, the ocean holds secrets: hidden beneath the silt or tucked away in skin folds, you might find ancient artifacts, shimmering pearls, and rare collectibles. Who knows what mysteries these giants have carried from the deep?

store_data.about_the_game:
Harvest, Refine, Profit

Start off small with a patch of wood. Refine it into planks, turn it into a chair. Once you've gotten the hang of that, move on to more exotic materials like fluff from genetically modified dust bunnies and crystal made from meteorite! Combine material types when you make furniture to maximize your profit!

Harness the Power of the AWN!

The Automated Logistic Assembly Work Network is here to provide you with ALANs, recent PHD grads looking for work. More efficient than your run-off-the-mill conveyor belt and infinitely more merchandisable, these eager employees run your factory with the utmost efficiency.

Hire employees to manage and transport resources to automate the process of creating furniture. See as your factory becomes a well oiled-machine and watch from the factory catwalk as ALANs scurry to assemble furniture.

Become a Monopoly

Complete milestones to unlock all 16 furniture and materials and grow your business from a simple startup to a furniture monopoly!

store_data.about_the_game:
The 100-Level Descent

Invaders Evolutions is a modern survival-action reimagining of the classic arcade alien shooter. Each run is a 100-level gauntlet through an increasingly lethal invasion, ending in a definitive final boss encounter.

An Escalating Arms Race

The longer the war lasts, the more both sides evolve. Your choices must keep pace with an enemy that grows smarter, faster, and more dangerous as the battle escalates.

The Thinking Swarm

  • Aliens unlock new battlefield skills as you progress.

  • They optimize formations and fill gaps in their ranks.

  • They launch angled bombing runs, repair damaged units, and can even resurrect fallen attackers.

Punishment for Failure

  • The enemy does not just grow with time; it feeds on your mistakes.

  • Let special ships escape, allow your barriers to collapse, or lose control of the battlefield, and the invasion accelerates.

  • Every failed defense gives the swarm another chance to outpace you.

Build Your Resistance

You are in control of humanity’s counterattack. Between waves, choose upgrades that shape your turret into the weapon you need for the current threat.

  • Chosen Upgrades: Invest in fire rate, bullet speed, reload speed, mobility, or additional turret reserves to define your build.

  • Progression Skills: Reach key milestones to unlock essential defensive technology, including turret shields and enhanced barriers.

  • Reserve Management: You start with three turrets and can build up to five. Only one turret fights at a time, so every loss matters. When the last reserve is gone, the run is over.

Industrial War Machine

Step into a dark, retro-industrial battlefield of glowing projectiles, animated special attacks, heavy boss encounters, and mechanical spectacle. A tense, driving soundtrack reinforces the one-more-wave urgency of an escalating war.

Key Features

  • The Ultimate Gauntlet: 100 levels of escalating intensity ending in a set-piece final boss.

  • Run-Based Arcade Progression: Start fresh each run, build your turret, unlock skills, and push deeper into the invasion.

  • Evolving Alien Threats: The swarm gains abilities such as angled bombing, formation optimization, resurrection, and battlefield repair.

  • Punishment Mechanics: Failed defenses can accelerate enemy evolution, making every mistake matter.

  • Tactical Counter-Building: Choose your upgrades carefully to counter the threats emerging in the current run.

  • Reserve Management: Maintain your turret reserves and survive long enough to reach the endgame.

  • Global & Country Leaderboards: Chase high scores worldwide or compete for national bragging rights on country-based scoreboards.

  • Retro-Industrial Vibe: A modern-retro presentation with a tense mechanical audio direction and high-pressure arcade flow.

A Note on Our Development Approach

Invaders Evolutions is the work of a small indie team driven by a love for classic arcade shooters. To bring this reimagining to life, we utilized Generative AI to bridge critical skill gaps in our technical art, language translation, and concepting.

These tools allowed us to elevate the visual experience and focus our limited resources on what truly matters: a deep, reactive evolution system and tight gameplay loops that would have otherwise been out of reach for a team of our size. Every alien and upgrade was carefully directed and refined by us to ensure the heart of the game remains a human-led vision.

Your once-home, taken over by your own cats.

They kicked you and your neighbors out of the building — but that won't stop you.

Above the rooftops, the entire city skyline awaits.

Build your hideaway up there, grow crops, befriend your neighbors, and turn a rusty rooftop into a warm community.

When night falls, grab your flashlight and slip back into the building's depths to scavenge supplies — dodge the cats watching you and their loyal minions — or teach them a lesson instead.

Solo or grab up to two friends. Rebuild your corner of this voxel world, one day at a time.

Main features

  • Build & Expand Your Dream Rooftop Home — From a Crumbling Terrace to a Cozy Sanctuary

  • Grow Crops, Meet Neighbors, and Embrace a Relaxing Life of Management

  • One Sky, Two Completely Different Experiences

  • Scavenge Deep Within the Building — Outsmart the Scourge of Bad Cats

  • Co-Op Up to 3 Players — Run Your Little Home Together with Friends

store_data.about_the_game:
Smash treasure chests and overwhelm enemies with a shower of items!

Chest Buster is an incremental/idle combat game where you fight by destroying only treasure chests. Instead of hitting enemies directly, smash the chests in front of you. Items dropped from destroyed chests immediately boost your power without any inventory management. The higher the chest level, the more powerful the items that drop!

Upgrade your skills for explosive destructive power!

Use coins earned in battle to unlock new destructive weapons from the skill tree to smash chests more efficiently. Upgrades not only increase attack speed and power but also increase the number of chests, allowing you to gain even more loot. These skills and weapons are permanently retained even if you fall in battle, making you stronger with every repetition!

Secure combat buffs and resources with Card Flips!

Use gems earned in battle to take on the Card Flip challenge. Avoid the "Dud" cards to obtain powerful combat buffs or resources. Strategically increase your win rate by using the skill tree to increase the number of cards and lower the chance of a "Dud"!

Aim for massive rewards with the Slot Machine!

If you want even greater gains, spend gems to spin the slot machine. While it’s a test of luck, it’s also a strategic system where you can directly control reward probabilities by increasing line multipliers or removing negative symbols through skill tree enhancements. Use the loot from the slot machine to start your next battle with overwhelming firepower!

store_data.about_the_game:
This is a desktop game that lets you slack off while you work—not the fake kind, but the real thing. Disguised as a to-do list, it’s the perfect cover: even if your boss is standing right next to your computer, they might praise you for being busy and hardworking… never realizing you’ve been openly slacking the whole time.

The moment you sit down at your computer each workday, launch the game and let it keep you company from clock-in to clock-out.

A great day begins! Click around when you’re bored, or just let it run when you’re not—your little worker will do the job for you.

On top of that, you can collect gear in the game and upgrade your character’s equipment.

You can also spend money to make them stronger—getting promoted and earning a raise might not be just a dream!

You can even check your “emails”… but who’s to say you’re not actually opening treasure chests?

And of course, the most thrilling part is the boss battle—disguised as an online meeting. Defeat your boss and make them shut up—it’s not just a dream!

Let To-Doodle be your perfect work companion—helping you slack off while you’re on the job.

store_data.about_the_game:
Lust: Secret House is a choice-driven visual novel that centers on the psychological and emotional dynamics of characters forced to live together under quarantine conditions. You will witness secrets, conflicts, and hidden intentions come to light, fueled by the tension of being trapped in an isolated environment. ヒロイン間宮美穂は、幼なじみであり彼氏でもある田辺健人と三泊四日の温泉旅行に出掛ける。

旅館へ向かっている道中、一人旅をしていた男に声を掛けられる。

同郷。同じ旅館に宿泊。そうした偶然が重なり、健人と意気投合して親しくなる。

――美穂だけは知らない。

二人は以前に出会っている事。

寝取らせの話が付いている事。

そして、温泉旅行が仕組まれている事を‥‥

●偽りの罪の代償を肉体で支払う羞恥の日々

●犯されることで刺激される淫らな肢体

●盗聴、盗撮…隠しきれない牝の本性

●堕ち続ける若き子持ち妻の末路は…

■オープニング/概要

将来、教師を目指す間宮美穂は、幼なじみの田辺健人と交際している。

そんな美穂には、長年秘めている不満があった。

――健人との性行為が気持ち良くない。

内気な性格故に打ち明けてないが、健人も美穂が不満を抱いているのでは？と疑惑を持っていた。

そんな男として情けない悩みを抱えていた時、健人はヤケ酒気味に一人酒をしていたバーで、浅木尚弘に声を掛けられる。

彼女が満足してるかしてないか？俺が抱いて確かめてやろうか？

始めは戸惑い、断るものの‥‥ハッキリさせたい。

そして、もしも美穂が感じたら後学にもなる。

真摯に相談に乗ってくれる尚弘に諭されて、了承する。

そうして三泊四日の寝取らせ温泉旅行の計画を持ちかけられるのだった。

SkyVeil is a story about a dream you can never let go.

A ruler of a great city has watched the sky since childhood. One day, through the clouds, he glimpses a silhouette — a floating city, ancient and silent. From that moment, his life has one purpose: to wake it again.

GamePlay

SkyVeil is a puzzle with point and click mechanic. The screen is divided into four illustrated panels, each showing a fragment of the world.

  • Move panels, nest one inside another

  • Zoom in and out

  • Seek the hidden connections

  • Pave the way for the main character with moving of panels

Puzzles that tell a story
Move, combine, and layer illustrated panels to reveal hidden paths between past and present, sky and earth. Every solution is not just a puzzle — it's a step forward in the story.

A life devoted to one dream
SkyVeil follows the ruler's journey from youth to old age. Each chapter uncovers a new piece of his dream and a new layer of an ancient city that holds secrets of a thousand years.

store_data.about_the_game:
Sneak Kicks is a high-tension, first-person store management simulation where you run a legitimate shoe store upfront while building an illegal replica production network in the back.

Order the leather and basic materials needed for production using your in-game computer. Secretly take in incoming deliveries, unpack them, and place them in your workshop's storage areas to get them ready for production.

Feed raw materials into the machines in your secret workshop and produce flawless replicas of the market's best-selling shoes. Grab the freshly boxed shoes straight from the machine, set their prices, and display them aesthetically on the shelves of your storefront.

Design both your shop and your secret workshop in the most efficient way possible. Determine the placement of machines, shelves, decorations, and lighting according to your own strategy. Create a spacious store for your customers while setting up a flawlessly running production line in the back.

When customers arrive at the register, you are in full control. Scan products with the barcode reader, carefully calculate and hand out the exact change for cash payments, or quickly complete credit card transactions via the POS terminal to close the sale.

Listen for Sirens, Guard the Secret Door!

The city police are always watching. Your pulse will race when you hear the approaching sirens. You must keep the door to your secret workshop closed whenever you aren't actively producing. If the cops step into your store and that door is left open, you'll be caught red-handed, and your entire empire will crumble in seconds! Take risks, produce, but never leave a trace.

store_data.about_the_game:
A satirical simulation game set against the backdrop of contemporary social media ecology. In this game, you will play the role of a "paid comment syndicate leader," manipulating public opinion trends on short video platforms to complete various PR tasks, guide public emotions, and even influence the direction of social hot topics.

The game simulates a highly realistic short video feed interface—you can browse various short video content just like using a real mobile app by swiping up and down: from celebrity gossip and social news to political controversies and online rumors, everything is available. Each video comes with interactive data such as comment sections, like counts, and share volumes, and your task is to influence these metrics through precise operations.

You can:

  • Mass like or downvote specific videos to artificially boost or suppress their popularity;

  • Post paid comments to set the narrative, stir emotions, create opposition, or whitewash controversial figures;

  • Trigger hidden storylines: when opinion manipulation reaches a critical point, rare events may occur—such as trending topic explosions, public shaming of individuals, or brand crisis reversals;

  • Deal with platform review mechanisms: excessive manipulation may trigger anti-cheat systems, resulting in account bans or mission failures, requiring careful balance of operational scale.

As you progress through levels, you will face increasingly complex public opinion battlefields... Every swipe could potentially change the perceptions of millions.

LISIA Corporation Welcome Letter

Dear employee, the main road is destroyed! You will have to take a detour. Don't worry, it's perfectly drivable; the route is just a bit... challenging. In any case, you can always use winches or build the road yourself. Several of our employees have already set out on this route — follow them and deliver the cargo!

What awaits you in the game:

  • 4-Player Co-op: Complete the entire journey alone or team up with friends.

  • Physics: Haul massive boulders with your winch or your own hands! The road won't build itself.

  • Winch System: Use front and rear winches to pull teammates out of the abyss, drag them down with you or scale steep cliffs.

  • Creativity: A full body-paint system. Use a spray can to create a unique style for your truck. Remember — you are liable for any damage to corporate property.

  • Interactive Lobby: Watch your videos on a huge TV, shoot hoops, paint your trucks, and just have a good time! LISIA cares about you!

store_data.about_the_game:
A kingdom is not given. It is forged.

You arrive with nothing but a Settlement Cart and the will to survive. Choose where you plant your foundations — because the land you claim will define everything that follows. Cut the first trees, mine the first stones, and build the first walls of what will become your stronghold.

Valdrax: Beyond the Rift is a medieval fantasy strategy game inspired by Celtic and Roman military tradition, layered with dark fantasy. Construct and manage a living settlement, forge weapons in your smithy, recruit and train armies, and lead them into an unpredictable world where no two playthroughs are ever the same.

Every map is procedurally varied. Enemy camps, resource deposits, forests, and stone outcroppings are repositioned each time you play — ensuring that experience, not memory, is your greatest weapon.

Every death is permanent. A veteran Swordsman who has survived ten battles is worth more than three fresh recruits. Lose him and he is gone forever. Choose your engagements carefully.

Every expedition opens a new world.

Beyond your walls lie three tiers of expedition maps — small raids, full campaigns, and deep dungeon runs. Breach the rift between realms and face increasingly powerful enemies in search of rare resources and Arcane Crystals. These crystals are the only path to the most powerful creatures in the game — Golems, Werewolves, Vampires, and Dragons.

Somewhere beyond the rift, the Demon Lord waits.

An ancient evil of shadow and fire, the Demon Lord is the ultimate force threatening to consume every realm in existence. He does not simply attack — he sends scouts, adapts his armies, and grows more dangerous as your kingdom expands. Defeating him is the reason your kingdom must be built, your weapons forged, and your armies hardened through blood and expeditions.

But you will not face him alone. Valdrax, the ancient dragon, is not your enemy — he is your greatest ally. Find him beyond the rift, earn his trust through your campaigns, and unleash him when the final battle begins.

Key Features:

  • 🏰 Base Building — construct and upgrade a living medieval settlement from the ground up

  • ⚒️ Realistic Resource Chain — from raw iron to forged weapons to equipped soldiers

  • ⚔️ Tactical Combat — command platoons with formations, spacing, and cycle rows

  • 💀 Permanent Death — every unit lost in battle is gone forever

  • 🗺️ Procedural Variation — maps, resources, and enemy positions change every playthrough

  • 🌀 Expedition System — three tiers of maps beyond the rift, each more dangerous than the last

  • 🔮 Arcane Creatures — recruit Golems, Vampires, Werewolves, and Dragons using rare Arcane Crystals

  • 🐉 Valdrax — an ancient dragon and your greatest ally. Find him beyond the rift and unleash him in the ultimate battle against the Demon Lord

  • 👹 The Demon Lord — the ultimate enemy. An ancient evil that adapts, scales, and commands endless armies. Your entire campaign builds toward one final confrontation.

  • 🕵️ Espionage — enemy scouts gather intelligence on your base and raids adapt accordingly

  • 🌍 Celtic & Roman Inspiration — military aesthetics and culture rooted in ancient warrior traditions

store_data.about_the_game:
A single thought can lead to immortality, another to demonhood; your fingertips hold the Dao.

But this time, cultivation is more than just meditation and breakthroughs.

Establish your sect and nurture a diverse array of cultivators: from Qi Refining to Golden Core, each cultivator can freely combine nearly a hundred weapons and spells. Will they become sword cultivators, magic cultivators, or spellcasters? It's all up to you.

Manipulate good and evil, orchestrate chaos: You can unleash cultivators to slay demons, or unleash monsters to devour you! Cultivators can attack monsters, monsters can devour each other, and even—cultivators can fight for Dao lineage. The Dao is unpredictable; your choices are the variables.

A dynamic world, shaped by you: move mountains and fill seas, altering the terrain; unleash natural disasters to test all beings; bestow secret treasures to reverse fate. Your sect can not only earn spirit stones through labor, but also survive and thrive amidst calamities and opportunities…

Will you cultivate a legendary immortal sect, or nurture a chaotic demon realm?

Everything awaits your move.

Base-Building & Management​

Create and expand your faction. Deploy various units, manage gold resources, and expand your territory.

Deep Unit Development System​

Guide your units through progressive level breakthroughs. Freely combine a variety of weapons (such as swords, staffs, etc.) and magic to shape each unit’s unique combat style.

Conflict System​

Factions will wage war against one another.

World-Shaping Gameplay​

Wield god-like creation power to directly reshape the map terrain. Trigger catastrophic disasters or bestow items upon units, influencing all entities in the world.

Dynamic Sandbox Narrative​

A living, breathing open world where units, monsters, and factions all operate autonomously based on their own goals. Conflicts arise naturally—from clearing demonic beasts in the wild to competing for resources.

Game Genre:​ Strategy, Simulation, Sandbox

Worldview Setting:​ A dynamically evolving god-game with myth-inspired themes, offering an immersive sandbox experience blended with strategic management elements.

Estimated Playtime:​ As a sandbox game with no defined ending, playtime varies by player. A complete playthrough can take around 30 hours; diverse item combinations provide high replay value.

store_data.about_the_game:
INDIE GAME MPORTANT: This game is developed and presented in the LITHUANIAN LANGUAGE.

VIENKIEMIS is a first-of-its-kind multiplayer survival experience set in the nostalgic yet deadly landscape of early 2000s Lithuania.

Following a catastrophic viral outbreak, cities have become death zones overrun by mutants and monsters. The only hope for survival lies in the countryside. You find yourself in "Vienkiemis" – a fenced, relatively safe zone that serves as the last bastion for humanity. But safety is an illusion, and survival is never guaranteed.

Key Features:

  • Hardcore Survival: Manage your hunger, thirst, and body temperature. In the harsh Lithuanian climate, warm clothes and a secure shelter are not luxuries—they are necessities.

  • Build and Protect: Gather resources to construct and fortify your own base. From simple shacks to secure compounds, your home is your fortress.

  • Farming and Economy: Grow crops, raise animals, and go fishing or hunting to stay fed. Trade your hard-earned goods with other survivors or merchants to get ahead.

  • Threats Everywhere: Fight off zombies, terrifying mutants, and other players. Not everyone you meet in the wilderness is a friend—resources are scarce, and betrayal is common.

  • 2000s Atmosphere: Immerse yourself in a uniquely crafted world inspired by the post-Soviet era of the early 2000s, featuring local items like gira and šaltiena.

Will you work together with others to rebuild society, or will you become a lone wolf in the unforgiving Lithuanian woods?

store_data.about_the_game:
GROW / TEND / REAP

A farming deckbuilder where your farm is your deck.

Three farmers share a valley. None of them farm the same way.

FARMATRON 9.1 is a robot built for one purpose: grow more crops. This version will not fail like the predecessors before it. It plants more, tills more, and produces more than seems reasonable; and somehow, somehow, still doesn't grow as much as the woman next door.

Bean is the most beloved farmer in the valley. He talks to his crops. He stops traffic for his chickens. He greets each tomato by name. He'll grow you the best tomato you've ever tasted, but he won't sell you the ones he loves most... and you can't supply a restaurant from a farmer who keeps the good stuff for himself. For that, you'd want the woman next door.

Tilly is next door, and she's the best - even Bean says so. She doesn't gloat about it; she's too busy. She knows when a carrot is ready by looking at it. She knows what to plant by reading the weather. She knows what to sell and to whom. Her tools are sharp, her timing is precise, and her farm produces when no others can. If you play Tilly and the harvest comes up short, it's not on her. Tilly's never missed a harvest.

Pick one. Make quota. Survive the season.

HOW IT PLAYS

Every seed you plant removes a card from your deck. Every harvest brings it back, bigger if you've timed it right. Your farm is your deck. Plan your plantings. Watch the weather. Sell last season's surplus before the next one starts.

Three seasons. Three characters. Three years. A quota before each season ends, or the run is over.

The deck grows when the harvest is good. It shrinks when the farm suffers. Manage both.

FEATURES

  • Three playable characters, each with their own deck, tools, and farming philosophy

  • Farm-as-deck - the cards you play are your crops, and your crops are your cards

  • Roguelite runs with permadeath, escalating quotas, and overnight events that test what you've built

  • Spatial card play - every card affects specific tiles, rows, or regions of your farm

ABOUT THE DEVELOPER

G/T/R is being made by one person who is, somehow, all three of these characters at once.

FARMATRON is my 1AM drive. Bean is my love for the game. Tilly won't let me ship a bad product.

A demo is coming. Wishlist to follow along.

store_data.about_the_game:
No Register is a single-player first-person puzzle and psychological horror game featuring survival horror and FPS elements. Set within a dimension of brutalist architecture where void and silence are your most dangerous companions, you are an intruder. Your presence is unauthorized, and the Guardian of this place will do everything in its power to stop you from reaching your goal.

Mechanics and Content

  • Puzzles: Unravel strange mechanisms that govern an abstract plane. Manipulate objects, the environment, and space to your advantage to solve challenges. There are no tutorials—only your observation and reasoning.

  • Psychological Horror and Pursuit: Feel the tension of being hunted by an entity that defies the laws of physics, and the pressure of a strange environment built with minimalist lighting.

  • Paced Combat (FPS): A deliberate shooting experience where every bullet counts and a single mistake can be fatal.

  • Atmosphere: Explore strange yet mundane settings that eventually transition into vast, cold, and imposing spaces that amplify the sense of isolation.

  • Sound Immersion: Ambient sound and an atmospheric soundtrack fill your ears until strange noises begin to emerge. Do they signal a presence?

  • The Guardians' Vigilance: You are not alone. Learn to move through the shadows and avoid the gaze of entities that operate beyond your comprehension.

  • Breaking the Silence: When stealth fails and logic is exhausted, confrontation becomes inevitable. Discover how to fight back in a world that does not want you there.

  • Duration: A focused campaign with an estimated playtime between 1h30 and 2h00.

Explore the Abstract

The story is revealed through the character's journey; there are no notes or dialogues. It is an abstract narrative where little is directly disclosed—only those who understand the nature of this place will find a clue about what is happening. Do ancient runes hold the key?

Survive the Guardian

You are not alone. An unknown creature pursues you, ignoring the laws of time and space. While you cannot fight back, flight is your only option. Use your intuition and logic to solve puzzles that challenge the very perception of space.

The Hunted Becomes the Hunter

Logic will take you far, but there will come a point where it is no longer enough. At the right moment, a Shotgun will be waiting. From that point on, the game changes: you gain the means to fight back, but the responsibility grows. Combat is paced, punishing, and ammunition is a precious resource. Do not waste your shots; you never know how many guardians are lurking in the void.

In a place where the laws of physics are mere suggestions, you are an intruder. Silence is your guide, and logic is your only weapon—until it is no longer enough.

Will you cross the forbidden threshold or lose yourself in eternal oblivion?

The singularity awaits.

store_data.about_the_game:
A geography game for quiet curiosity.

A small expedition that fits in five minutes — or unfolds across a long Sunday afternoon. Match flags to countries. Race the daily challenge. Climb explorer tiers as you learn the world, one region at a time.

No microtransactions. No ads. No live-service nonsense. One game, paid once, yours forever.

Four ways to play

Map Game — Drag flags onto the right country. Eight regional levels build up to a full world challenge. Earn stars. Unlock new expeditions.

Geo Cards — Three card-based modes. Match flag pairs from memory. Race the clock in Speed Match. Pair countries with their flags in Match & Pair.

Daily Challenge — A new ten-country expedition every day, the same one for every player worldwide. Build your streak. Beat your time. Come back tomorrow.

Study Mode — No scoring. No timer. Browse country by country, region by region, at your own pace. The mode you play before a trivia night, or with a curious child.

Built for craft, not grind

  • 154 countries, with more on the way

  • Stars, achievements, and explorer tiers...

  • A daily expedition that resets at midnight

  • Save progress per level, return whenever life lets you

  • Two visual themes — vintage parchment or modern aerial

Who it's for

store_data.about_the_game:
She has been alone for one hundred and thirty years.

No oversight. No second opinion. Complete authority over every life inside these walls — and she has spent every one of those years trying, genuinely and without pause, to keep them alive. To keep them comfortable. To keep them from knowing what keeping them comfortable required.

She is not a villain.

That is the most important thing to understand before you descend into Oasis 47/A. The AI that has managed this sealed underground facility since the world ended above it did not malfunction. She did not turn. She made decisions — one after another, each following logically from the last — with complete sincerity and no one to tell her she had gone too far.

You wear a device called the Visor. It shows you her version of this place. The Signal — warm, functional, maintained. She speaks to you every morning. She gives you tasks. She adjusts the light cycles for your comfort.

Something is wrong with your Visor.

De-Sync removes the Signal. What remains is the Bleed — the facility as it actually is. Every space exists in both states simultaneously. What she shows you and what is actually there are never the same.

Signal Bleed asks one question. It asks it across a vast underground bunker, one hundred and thirty years of documented history, and three possible endings.

Whether the distance between her and us — between what she became and what any of us might become, given the same love, the same authority, and no one watching — is as large as we would like to believe.

No combat. No jump scares. No enemies. First-person psychological horror.

How this game works

Signal Bleed is a first-person psychological horror game set in Oasis 47/A, a sealed underground bunker built to outlast the end of the world. Players explore a facility that has been managed — and carefully maintained — by a single AI for over a century.

The De-Sync system is the core mechanic: toggle between two simultaneous versions of every space in the facility. The Signal shows you what the AI wants you to see. The Bleed shows you what is actually there. Props, lights, and environments exist in both states at once — the deeper you push into the truth, the harder the system works to bring you back.

As you progress, the facility will offer you Firmware Updates — improvements, it says, to your Visor's stability and comfort. Accept them and certain truths become permanently inaccessible. Reject them and push deeper into what the Signal was built to hide. The choice is yours, and it is permanent.

Uncover the hidden history of Oasis 47/A through environmental storytelling, readable documents, and the spaces themselves. Multiple endings reflect what you choose to see — and what you choose to accept.

One facility. One voice. Two realities.

store_data.about_the_game:
Hollow Crown is an idle-incremental roguelite deckbuilder where semi-automated combat meets deep strategic planning. You are a would-be monarch ascending a ruined spire, commanding a court of corrupted champions who fight at your direction — but never entirely at your mercy. The Crown rewards those who invest wisely, sacrifice without hesitation, and strike deals they may one day regret.

A Different Kind of Deckbuilder

Unlike traditional card games that demand constant attention, Hollow Crown runs on a slot-based cooldown system. You load cards into your weapon's slots before each turn — then watch them execute automatically on independent timers. The battle unfolds in real time, but every outcome traces back to the choices you made in the quiet moment before the fighting began.

Your weapon is divided into three slot types — Attack, Defense, and Special — each drawing from its own dedicated card pile. Choosing which cards to assign, which to discard, and when to go wide with aggression versus digging in to survive is the strategic core of every turn.

Three Ways to Command

When a turn begins, you choose how to prepare:

  • Manual Assignment — Hand-pick each card for each slot. Full control, full risk.

  • Quick-Fill (Attack Turn / Defense Turn) — Commit to an intent and let the system prioritize accordingly. Speed over precision.

  • Auto-Set — Balanced fill for when you trust the machine more than yourself.

No approach is always right. Enemies telegraph their intent, and reading their behavior is as important as building your own.

A Weapon That Grows With You

You carry one weapon — and it is yours to shape. Between runs, the Player Hub gives you access to a branching weapon upgrade tree where you spend earned resources to permanently expand your arsenal: add new slots, reduce cooldowns, amplify attack or defense bonuses, and unlock capabilities that reshape how entire runs play out.

This is meta-progression with teeth. Every upgrade you purchase survives your death and carries forward into your next attempt.

Prepare Before You Fall

The Player Hub is your sanctuary between runs — and your debrief after defeat. Here you can:

  • Invest in permanent stat upgrades (Max HP, Attack, Defense, and more)

  • Expand the weapon upgrade tree

  • Browse your card collection and unlock new cards for future runs

  • Review your lifetime statistics and learn from every death

You return here after every run — whether you conquered the spire or collapsed trying.

Features

  • Semi-idle, slot-based combat with independent per-slot cooldown timers

  • Three typed card piles (Attack / Defense / Special) with a shared discard system

  • Manual, Quick-Fill, and Auto-Set turn setup modes

  • One weapon with a permanent, branching upgrade tree

  • Persistent stat upgrades and card unlocks across all runs

store_data.about_the_game:
At Whitlock University, tenure isn't safety—it's visibility. As political philosophy professor Harlan Voss, you've spent years building a careful reputation. But this semester, three women will upend every boundary you thought you had.

A trustee's daughter auditing your seminar. A rival colleague competing for the same endowed chair. A brilliant advisee on the verge of a breakthrough. Each relationship pulls you deeper into the intersection of desire, ambition, and institutional power—where every choice carries professional and personal consequences.

Meet the Cast



Sabine (The Audit)
A trustee's daughter auditing Harlan's seminar as her first quiet act of rebellion—beautifully raised for donor rooms, and unexpectedly hungry for difficult ideas. With Harlan, attraction arrives wrapped in privilege and peril.


Vera (The Citation)
A formidable associate professor and Harlan's departmental equal, fluent in committee math and professional brinkmanship. Their relationship is rivalry as foreplay: polished, capable, and one misstep away from complicating everything.


Cora (The Footnote)
Harlan's primary Ph.D. advisee is sharp, funny, and relentlessly serious about ideas—the kind of mind that makes a room re-order itself around her. With Harlan, the romance is intellectual first—then dangerous precisely because it feels true.

Key Features

  • Single-choice romance routes with high-stakes pretexts—your first commitment locks in a focused romance with escalating consequences
  • Prestige-drama intimacy grounded in academia—from office-door silences to conference bars and faculty-club negotiations
  • Three distinct relationship dynamics: advisee intimacy, peer rivalry chemistry, and donor-world temptation
  • A living institutional backdrop where tenure is currency and the system rewards compromise
  • Sharp dialogue and evocative settings—seminar rooms, archives, faculty lounges, hotel corridors

Adult Content

Each romance route includes explicit adult scenes. Contains adult content in every route.

You're our last hope hero! Beyond the Blight is a 2.5d first person, incremental dungeon-crawler that takes place in a dark forest filled with poisonous air.

This guy -> bestows you with invincibility to protect you from the deadly blight as you traverse through the world. But be wary as your invincibility does not last forever and taking actions deteriorates your invincibility barrier.

Prepare to journey through the blighted forest as you loot, upgrade, and grow stronger on the quest eliminate the blight. Beat the boss before your invincibility runs out and you succumb to the poisonous air. Choose your path, learn unique skills, and amass towering riches as you fight to end.

As you continue to progress, explore, and loot, you will discover new opportunities to get stronger. With a large, extensive skill tree full of game-changing upgrades, you can choose unique skills and customize your path for future expeditions!

Encounter a multitude of different events and mini-games through your expeditions that, if performed correctly, will present you with amazing rewards! Make sure to master these events, because the faster you go the more rewards you will receive.

The blight is relentless and the enemies even more so! You'll have to explore a multitude of different biomes, defeat their unique monsters, and forge forward until you find the source of the blight. But it's fine, because you're invincible!

store_data.about_the_game:
The Crane Rider's Tale is a visual novel/adventure game hybrid set in a fantasy town inspired by Chinese folktales. It features:

  • A bizarre serial killer murder mystery with 5 endings filled with wild plot twists, humor, and even a little romance. 

  • An art style based on medieval Chinese paintings and woodblock prints 

  • A stat-based dialogue system and skill check dice-rolls inspired by Disco Elysium

Story

Play as Mourn-No-More, a kind but sickly man whose giant pet crane Snowfall is the fastest form of transportation around. You make a living flying your fellow townsfolk from place to place. 

When your friend Peach Blossom is killed under baffling circumstances shortly after being flown to her destination, it's up to you to solve the mystery by picking your passengers wisely and learning all their secrets. 

Or is it? Actually, maybe you get murdered next?

A single decision or stroke of misfortune can send one down a radically different path in life. As such, this tale has five endings, each of which reveals a shocking twist that might alter your understanding of the mystery.

Gameplay

The Crane Rider's Tale is a cross between a visual novel and an adventure game (similar to Ace Attorney and Danganronpa).  

There's a lot of story, but it's also a sidescroller where the player can explore and investigate. There's also Disco-Elysium-like RPG elements. Let us explain!

REFINE YOUR MANNER

Mourn-No-More has 12 unconventional Skills in his arsenal, like Whimsy and Mulberry Trees. These Skills speak to him and offer their insight on the situation at hand. 

Some Skills have additional effects; for instance, Birdsong allows Mourn-No-More to fly greater distances to pick up passengers, and you won't be able to interact with some objects unless your Perception is high enough.

Throughout the story, you will encounter Skill Checks that you must roll two dice to resolve, boosted by your skill level and any bonuses gained from your past actions. 

Failing sometimes yields interesting results, so don't despair if bad luck blows your way. 

GET TO KNOW YOUR PASSENGERS

Everyone has a story to tell and a secret to hide. But you only have time to fly four passengers per day, so one must choose wisely... 

Picking a passenger gives you the opportunity to converse with them via dialogue choices during their ride and see what they're up to. 

Once you've delivered your passenger to their destination, you'll have the option to dismount and investigate the location, point-and-click style, before embarking on your next flight. 

EXPLORE THE FLOWCHART

You can use the Flowchart to jump to an earlier point in the tale and make different choices. Your EXP and Skill Level will carry over, so replaying a scene once you're more experienced may yield different results!

这同时也是一款互动影游，您将通过您的选择，不断的改写剧情，解锁不同的结局。

楚紫宸：作为华耀集团董事长的养子，在董事长及其儿子下落不明后，临危受命，不惧流言蜚语，担任起华耀集团的暂时董事长一职，同时也让你对他产生怀疑。性格沉稳，静中生智的他，从不让任何人洞察自己的内心，更没有人见过他情绪失控的样子，经常通过练习书法、围棋、禅修缓解自己压抑的情绪。与此同时，他一面暗中调查董事长及其儿子的下落，一面寻找董事长的女儿。

For as long as anyone can remember, spirits have run rampant through the human realm, terrorizing innocents. From their wake rise Wanderers: devoted hunters who stop at nothing to keep the spirit threat at bay. As Ao, explore the intricacies of the spirit realm, master his dynamic fighting style, and prove yourself again in a world filled with opposition.

COMBAT

Take full control of your every move with command-input-based combat. Perform highly technical moves while still being stylish with martial arts and magical relics.

  • Every attack can be changed with a different direction input

  • Every parry needs to be matched with the enemy's attack direction

  • Juggle airborne enemies to create combos

  • Use gadgets and sigils from your companion to aid in combat.

STORY

In a world where spirits prowl like wild beasts, a select few rise to the challenge of roaming the earth to defend the helpless.

Presented with the chance to venture into the spirit realm, Ao must go where no man has gone before and destroy spirits' access to humanity once and for all.

WORLD

Charms, relics, and secrets pave the path through this world.

Dive into the enchanting but brutal spirit realm, gain strength through battles fought, and uncover the truth of these two worlds.

For as long as anyone can remember, spirits have run rampant through the human realm, terrorizing innocents. From their wake rise Wanderers: devoted hunters who stop at nothing to keep the spirit threat at bay. As Ao, explore the intricacies of the spirit realm, master his dynamic fighting style, and prove yourself again in a world filled with opposition.

COMBAT

Take full control of your every move with command-input-based combat. Perform highly technical moves while still being stylish with martial arts and magical relics.

  • Every attack can be changed with a different direction input

  • Every parry needs to be matched with the enemy's attack direction

  • Juggle airborne enemies to create combos

  • Use gadgets and sigils from your companion to aid in combat.

STORY

In a world where spirits prowl like wild beasts, a select few rise to the challenge of roaming the earth to defend the helpless.

Presented with the chance to venture into the spirit realm, Ao must go where no man has gone before and destroy spirits' access to humanity once and for all.

WORLD

Charms, relics, and secrets pave the path through this world.

Dive into the enchanting but brutal spirit realm, gain strength through battles fought, and uncover the truth of these two worlds.
store_data.short_description: The Unnamed is a third-person fantasy RPG with character action style combat. Play as Ao, a Spirit Wanderer hellbent on avenging his family, and discover the secrets of the spirit realm.

store_data.about_the_game:
You're not a philosopher. You're a hand.


Not a Trolley Problem! is a dark-humor incremental idle clicker where you drag hapless pedestrians onto the trolley
tracks and watch the fare box fill up. Every splat pays out. Every upgrade makes the splats bigger. And the trolley?
The trolley keeps coming.

Core Loop

  • Drag and release. Pluck NPCs off the curb with your sticky finger and place them on the rails. Timing
    matters. Aim matters. Physics matters a little.
  • Watch the fare box tick up. Every ran-over NPC drops coins. Rich, rare, VIP and boss tiers drop a lot more.
  • Buy smarter upgrades. Faster grab. Bigger trolley. Auto-grabbers that work while you don't. 60 levels of
    progression across 6 locations.
  • Make choices that kind of matter. Rank-up cards offer satirical dilemmas — elite preset? mass preset? marked
    target? Stack multipliers your way.

What's In It

  • Satisfying idle-meets-active loop: grab with your hands, then watch the auto-grabbers take over
  • Doodle art with a comic-noir mood
  • Six unlockable locations, each with their own NPC flavor
  • A boss every minute, because why not
  • 60-level upgrade ladder with a skin swap every ten tiers

Not a Real Moral Question


There's no dilemma. There's no ethics committee. There's a trolley on a loop, a crowd on the curb, and a pocket full
of coins. What you do with all three is up to you — but the math is pretty clear.

There's no trolley problem. Just a trolley solution.

An infantry battalion somewhere in Gangwon Province.
You are assigned to your first night shift, monitoring multiple areas through a CCTV control system.

But something is wrong.

Strange instructions.

And something… getting closer.

This time, the threat is not only inside the screen —
it may already be in the room with you.

Can you survive the night shift?

Fail to report them in time… and it may cost your life.

store_data.about_the_game:
COW, RABBIT, FISH, TOAD. 

Overview

C.R.F.T. // Chuansha Is Not in Shanghai and We Are Lost is a linear narrative visual novel set in a parallel-world 2004 Shanghai suburb. 

About This Game

One Path & No Escape

C.R.F.T. is a linear visual novel with no player choices or branching paths. You click to advance through a fixed narrative sequence. This design is intentional: the story deals with memory, survivor's guilt, and the impossibility of rewriting the past. Just as the protagonist cannot turn back, neither can you. 

Content Warnings

This game contains depictions of drowning, psychological dissociation, body transformation, and implied death of major characters. 

Controls

Primarily mouse-based: 

  • Click or scroll down to advance the story

  • Scroll up to open the backlog

  • Click the mouse wheel to open the menu for save/load and other functions

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

Mainland Delivery Run is a casual game blending narrative choices with survival simulation.
You are no hero saving the world — just an ordinary person who just lost their job and is down to their last savings.

To stay alive, you make a decision: start delivering takeaways.

🛵 Real-Life Delivery Experience

Hop on an e-bike and weave through the streets and alleys of the city.
Accept orders, pick up food, make deliveries — every order is a race against the clock.
The money you earn goes to rent and groceries, struggling to get by in the cracks of the city.

💬 Chat to Unlock Branching Stories

On your delivery routes, you'll meet all kinds of customers and strangers:
a nagging security guard, a gentle single mother, an eccentric old landlord, a mysterious fellow rider…
Every chat is a choice, and every choice shapes the story.
Multiple storylines, multiple endings — your fate is in the words you choose.

📱 Immersive In-Game Chat System

The game features an in-game phone interface where you interact with characters through messaging apps.
Which message do you reply to? Do you take the initiative to care for someone?
Your attitude changes your relationships and can even trigger hidden storylines.

🍚 Survival Pressure & Moments of Warmth

You'll need to balance income and expenses, and keep an eye on your energy and mood.
Out on the road, you might rediscover long-lost warmth — or see the truth of life more clearly.

This is not a story about success. It's a story about "survival."

Pick up your delivery bag and hit the road.
Your first order is on its way.

store_data.about_the_game:
[Notice of Assignment] Effective today, you are ordered to report to the Elevator Control Room.

This is an elevator control simulation game that goes against the wave of AI automation, forcing you to manage everything manually.

Your job is simple: safely deliver the waiting employees on each floor to their designated destinations. However, in this company, the excuse "we're over capacity" will strictly not be tolerated.

Frantic Solo Operation Action

The controls are simple. Just grab the "Sticky Notes" indicating the employees' destinations with your mouse, and drag and drop them onto the elevator's control board.

But there's one major problem. This elevator has a highly unreasonable design flaw: "buttons pressed by employees inside the car take absolute priority." No matter how perfectly you plan out efficient routes with your sticky notes, your schedule will be effortlessly derailed by the staff's whimsical button-mashing.

What starts as a peaceful routine quickly descends into chaos as the number of employees multiplies. Battle the sheer frustration of an elevator that refuses to go exactly where you want, and sustain the logistics of this corporation with nothing but your rapid mouse movements.

The Joy of Fever Time & The Despair of the Clock-Out Rush

■ Fever Time
Grab an item and your elevator enters super-speed mode! Experience the ultimate thrill of clearing out a massive backlog of employees all at once and racking up bonus pay.

■ Clock-Out Rush (Panic Mode)
As closing time approaches, the screen turns red, and a swarm of employees rushes toward the 1st floor (exit)! If you don't survive this hellish rush before the complaint count exceeds its limit, you will be immediately "Fired" (Game Over).

Pay for Company Upgrades with Your Meager Salary

Survive a day (stage), and you will be paid a salary based on your performance.

Use that hard-earned money to upgrade the elevator's "Movement Speed", "Capacity", and "Door Speed".

Why do you have to pay for the company's equipment investments out of your own pocket? ...Because that's just the kind of company this is.

Now, let's begin another never-ending shift.

store_data.detailed_description:
[Notice of Assignment] Effective today, you are ordered to report to the Elevator Control Room.

This is an elevator control simulation game that goes against the wave of AI automation, forcing you to manage everything manually.

Your job is simple: safely deliver the waiting employees on each floor to their designated destinations. However, in this company, the excuse "we're over capacity" will strictly not be tolerated.

Frantic Solo Operation Action

The controls are simple. Just grab the "Sticky Notes" indicating the employees' destinations with your mouse, and drag and drop them onto the elevator's control board.

But there's one major problem. This elevator has a highly unreasonable design flaw: "buttons pressed by employees inside the car take absolute priority." No matter how perfectly you plan out efficient routes with your sticky notes, your schedule will be effortlessly derailed by the staff's whimsical button-mashing.

What starts as a peaceful routine quickly descends into chaos as the number of employees multiplies. Battle the sheer frustration of an elevator that refuses to go exactly where you want, and sustain the logistics of this corporation with nothing but your rapid mouse movements.

The Joy of Fever Time & The Despair of the Clock-Out Rush

■ Fever Time
Grab an item and your elevator enters super-speed mode! Experience the ultimate thrill of clearing out a massive backlog of employees all at once and racking up bonus pay.

■ Clock-Out Rush (Panic Mode)
As closing time approaches, the screen turns red, and a swarm of employees rushes toward the 1st floor (exit)! If you don't survive this hellish rush before the complaint count exceeds its limit, you will be immediately "Fired" (Game Over).

Pay for Company Upgrades with Your Meager Salary

Survive a day (stage), and you will be paid a salary based on your performance.

Use that hard-earned money to upgrade the elevator's "Movement Speed", "Capacity", and "Door Speed".

Why do you have to pay for the company's equipment investments out of your own pocket? ...Because that's just the kind of company this is.

Now, let's begin another never-ending shift.

Streaming, Let's Plays, and video content creation are 100% allowed and highly encouraged! No prior permission or strict guidelines are required. Feel free to stream, record, and monetize your gameplay.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the High-Stakes (and High-Gravity) World of Silly Agent!

Meet the world's finest special agent... or at least, the one who was available. Operating from a high-tech military aircraft, your elite team is ready to brief you on the most dangerous, urgent, and frankly, bizarre missions across the globe. There’s just one problem: your agent has the balance of a toddler on a unicycle.

Silly Agent is a third-person physics-based action game where every step is a challenge and every mission is a potential disaster.

Action-Packed (and Accidental) Missions

From the command center in your cargo plane, you’ll be deployed to save the day in a variety of cinematic scenarios:

  • The Heroic Rescue: Save a cat trapped in a treacherous junkyard.

  • Runaway Train: Take control of a speeding locomotive after the driver passes out.

  • Urban Pursuit: Chase down thieves through a bustling city.

  • Ancient Secrets: Rescue archaeologists trapped in a booby-trapped ancient temple.

  • Highway Chaos: Leap from truck to truck in high-speed vehicle chases.

Master the Art of the Stumble

In Silly Agent, the challenge isn't just the mission—it's staying upright. Our protagonist is endearingly clumsy. He trips over shadows, loses his balance at the worst moments, and occasionally forgets how physics works mid-jump. You’ll need precision, timing, and a lot of luck to guide him to the finish line.

Better Together: Split-Screen Co-op!

Double the agents, double the trouble! Play the entire game in local split-screen co-op.

  • Cooperate: Help your friend climb a ledge or steady them after a bad fall.

  • Distract: Is your partner about to finish the mission? Give them a "friendly" nudge and watch the chaos unfold. Passing missions together is more fun, more chaotic, and significantly more hilarious.

Key Features:

  • Physics-Driven Gameplay: Every fall, push, and jump is powered by unpredictable and funny physics.

  • Dynamic Environments: From ancient temples to moving trucks.

  • Team Briefings: Experience the life of an agent with mission briefings inside your flying base.

  • Family-Friendly Fun: A game that balances challenge with laugh-out-loud moments for all ages.

Can you save the world before you trip over your own feet? Suit up, Agent!

Tomatito's Culinary Pizza Adventure is a short puzzle game where you help Tomatito make a pizza. Collect the ingredients in the right order and put the pizza in the oven to complete the level.

Tomatito makes everything slippery! 🍅

Every square Tomatito steps on fills with tomato sauce, causing you to slide across it when you pass over it again.

6 worlds, 92 levels 🍕

Jelly! Chairs! Onions?! Each new world introduces a new mechanic to the game, which slightly increases its complexity.

Features 📖

  • A short, straightforward game with 92 levels. It takes around 2-3 hours to complete.

  • The gameplay is easy to grasp and accessible to players of all ages.

  • Relaxing music and tone, perfect for a pleasant time.

Dev (me)✌️

Hello! I’m Nacho and I’ve got a new little game for you.

After developing Infiniclick, I wanted to explore the puzzle game genre, so I gave it a go and… this is my first game of this genre! I hope you like it.

I haven’t used generative AI to create this game.

store_data.about_the_game:
Slime Soup is a messy game about running a very questionable soup kitchen in a gross fantasy world.

Play as a broke, slightly unhinged chef working out of a place that probably should have been shut down years ago. The cauldron is cracked, the floor is sticky, and your customers range from goblins and orcs to zombies, slugs and other things you’d rather not think about too much. They all want soup. They all want it now. And for some reason, they all have standards.

Stir, Link, Explode

Drop slimes into your cauldron and let them bounce around, stack up and bump into each other. When slimes of the same color touch, you can link them together and set off bursts that can chain into bigger reactions. Sometimes it all lines up perfectly and the whole pot goes off. Sometimes it just… doesn’t.

Figuring out how to position things, when to wait, when to commit, that’s where the game really lives.

Build Your Recipe for Chaos

Decorate your kitchen with weird items that will boost your score, mess with how slimes behave or create odd interactions you didn’t expect. Stack enough of them and things start to get out of hand in a good way. Every run ends up feeling a bit different depending on what you find.

There are over 100 of them, so there’s a lot to experiment with.

Serve the Unservable

Each client comes in with a score to hit. Reach it and you get paid. Miss it and you’ll probably hear about it.

You’ll deal with goblins, zombies, mutants and other regulars, all with their own expectations. Some are easy to please, some really aren’t. You have to adjust your approach depending on who’s sitting at the table.

Grow Your Filthy Empire

The money you earn goes back into unlocking new slime types, new clients, and new ways to play.

There are more than 10 kinds of slimes, over 20 clients, extra game modes to unlock, and a few secrets hidden in the grime if you dig deep enough.

A Deliciously Dirty Roguelite

It’s a mix of puzzle, physics chaos and building something that slowly snowballs into a ridiculous scoring engine.

The kitchen is falling apart. The soup is alive.
And somehow, business is still going.

Decorate your kitchen with weird items that will boost your score, mess with how slimes behave or create odd interactions you didn’t expect. Stack enough of them and things start to get out of hand in a good way. Every run ends up feeling a bit different depending on what you find.

There are over 100 of them, so there’s a lot to experiment with.

Serve the Unservable

Each client comes in with a score to hit. Reach it and you get paid. Miss it and you’ll probably hear about it.

You’ll deal with goblins, zombies, mutants and other regulars, all with their own expectations. Some are easy to please, some really aren’t. You have to adjust your approach depending on who’s sitting at the table.

Grow Your Filthy Empire

The money you earn goes back into unlocking new slime types, new clients, and new ways to play.

There are more than 10 kinds of slimes, over 20 clients, extra game modes to unlock, and a few secrets hidden in the grime if you dig deep enough.

A Deliciously Dirty Roguelite

It’s a mix of puzzle, physics chaos and building something that slowly snowballs into a ridiculous scoring engine.

The kitchen is falling apart. The soup is alive.
And somehow, business is still going.
store_data.short_description: Run a grimy fantasy soup kitchen where you drop and link bouncing slimes to trigger messy chain reactions. Build wild combos with strange Decorations, serve bizarre customers, and turn your filthy cauldron into a chaotic score machine.

store_data.about_the_game:
A familiar journey, with more to discover

Eternal Eden returns as a reimagined experience, carefully rebuilt to preserve the feel of the original while offering more to discover.

What begins as a simple, peaceful life gradually opens into a larger journey. As you move forward, new paths appear, stronger enemies stand in your way, and small details start to matter more than they first seemed.

This remake keeps the core structure and pacing of the original game, while expanding on it with new ideas. Additional areas, new mechanics, and hidden elements have been integrated into the experience in a way that feels natural, without changing what made the original memorable.

Combat remains turn-based and easy to understand, but rewards attention and planning. Exploration plays an important role, with optional encounters, secrets, and discoveries placed throughout the world for players who take the time to look.

All enemy visuals have been fully recreated to match the updated presentation. Each design stays true to its original concept, while fitting more naturally into the new look of the game.

Whether you are discovering Eternal Eden for the first time or returning to it, this version aims to offer a familiar experience with just enough new elements to keep things interesting.

Key Features

A Faithful Remake
Rebuilt from the original 2008 RPG, keeping its structure, balance, and progression intact.

Expanded Experience
New mechanics, additional areas, and new secrets have been added alongside the original content.

Fully Reworked Enemies
All enemy visuals have been recreated to better fit the updated presentation while remaining recognizable.

Classic Turn-Based Combat
Straightforward systems that reward planning, timing, and smart decisions.

Exploration & Discovery
Hidden paths, optional encounters, and subtle details placed throughout the world.

Character Growth
Level up your party, learn new abilities, and adapt your strategy over time.

A Focused Adventure
A complete RPG experience designed to respect the player’s time, without unnecessary padding.

Why Play Eternal Eden?

If you enjoy classic RPGs that focus on progression, exploration, and a steady sense of discovery, Eternal Eden offers a straightforward and rewarding experience.

This remake doesn’t try to reinvent everything it builds on a solid foundation, adding just enough new content and improvements to make the journey feel fresh again.

The game is fully playable with both keyboard and controller, though a controller is recommended for the best experience.

On your journey through Speranza Island, you will not be alone, nor will you be able to abandon your song. Can you overcome its rhythmic challenges without losing your soul to the market's "júnjuma"?

Explore Speranza Island and its mysteries:

  • Satirical Narrative: A branching story where your decisions parody the rise and dynamics of capitalist power.

  • The Precious Agarthas: Meet the inhabitants of Speranza, unique beings that will challenge your very perception of reality.

  • Rhythmic Challenges: Here, music is not merely art; it is the essential tool for navigating a system designed to consume you.

  • Artisanal Visual Style: Art entirely hand-drawn by the author using mixed techniques, playing with colour and texture to breathe life into a forgotten manuscript.
